title: Senior Product Manager
description:
The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, design, and delivery of products within the Private Funds domain of the Clearwater system. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from defining the product and planning development through production and go-to-market. You will build the product roadmap needed to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets for your component.

This is a technical product role. You will work with engineering on data models, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, and you will be a domain authority on how private funds are structured, reported, and valued. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new capabilities, partner with development teams to build and launch them, and pilot new features with clients before promoting them to the wider client base.

**Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and guide a team of 8-15 developers, supporting knowledge-sharing and training to build team effectiveness.
* **Product Ownership:** Own the Private Funds product(s) end to end, from ideation through market launch and ongoing evolution.
* **Backlog Management:** Prioritize and manage the backlog, balancing client-facing features, data quality, and platform investments in line with business goals.
* **Technical Requirement Definition:** Write clear, detailed requirements and acceptance criteria, including data model changes, schema definitions, API contracts, validation rules, and data lineage expectations.
* **Private Funds Data Modeling:** Define and evolve the domain data model, including GP/LP structures, master/feeder relationships, fund and asset taxonomies and sub-types, and the treatment of capital account and PCAP statements, capital call and distribution notices, and NAV and performance data.
* **Data Versioning & Integrity:** Specify how data is versioned, corrected, and restated (e.g., immutable, transaction-based designs), and define approaches to entity matching, alias/deduplication, and reconciliation across sources.
* **AI & Automation:** Shape and prioritize agentic and Generative AI capabilities, such as automated document procurement, extraction, classification, and validation. Define accuracy targets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, and evaluation methods.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work daily with engineering on architecture trade-offs, feature design, and delivery, ensuring solutions meet client needs and scale with data volume and complexity.
* **Roadmap Creation:** Develop and communicate the product roadmap, setting strategic direction for analytics, research and deal management, managed data services, and accounting capabilities.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Keep stakeholders informed on product updates, roadmap progress, and releases.
* **Client Engagement:** Engage with Clients of Clearwater who maybe a GP, LP to understand their workflows and data needs, and translate them into actionable enhancements.
* **Operational Partnership:** Work with data operations and service teams to measure and reduce manual intervention, turning root causes into product and automation improvements.
* **Success Measurement:** Define KPIs (e.g., data accuracy, coverage, timeliness, straight-through processing rates, adoption, NPS) and use data-driven insights to guide future decisions.
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Act as the go-to expert on private funds and alternative investments, supporting sales, client conversations, and product strategy.
* **Employee Engagement:** Participate in large-scale initiatives that promote employee retention and engagement.
* **Process Improvement:** Teach and guide other teams toward effective processes and best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
* Deep knowledge of Private Markets (Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Assets, Fund of Funds) and the financial services landscape.
* Strong understanding of private fund structures and documents, including LPAs, capital account statements, PCAPs, capital calls and distributions, and NAV and performance reporting.
* Working technical fluency: relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, data pipelines, and ETL concepts. You can read schemas and engage credibly in design discussions.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and agentic AI technologies, including document intelligence, extraction, and evaluation, and an understanding of their practical limits in financial data workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate across sales, product, operations, and technology.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and documentation abilities.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and strong computer skills.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in product management or related roles, including experience owning a technical or data-intensive product.
* 4+ years of professional experience in Investment Management, Operations, or Accounting, with direct exposure to private funds data or workflows.
* Demonstrated experience writing business and technical requirements for a financial technology product or service.
* Experience in data visualization and analytics.
* Demonstrated client engagement experience, with a focus on understanding and addressing client needs.
* Experience presenting to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Alternative Investments, including Private Equity, Limited Partnerships, Private Credit, Mortgage and Bank Loans, or Derivatives.

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with fund administration, LP reporting, or portfolio monitoring platforms.
* Experience with master data management, entity resolution, or data quality frameworks.
* Hands-on experience launching AI-enabled data extraction or document processing products.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

**Build agents that get compliance work done.** Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

**Make agent behavior measurable and reliable.** Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

**Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior.** Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

**Build and improve workflows yourself.** Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

**Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together.** Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

**Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize.** Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **At least two years of product management experience**, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
* **Hands-on experience with AI evaluations.** You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
* **Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.** These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
* **Strong judgment about agentic user experiences.** You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
* **Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence.** You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
* **Strong ownership and organizational skills.** You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
* **A willingness to get into the details.** You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
* **Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.** You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
* **Curiosity and rigor in complex domains.** You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

**About the team**
------------------

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Health insurance.
* A monthly self-improvement stipend for learning, fitness, or other investments in your development.
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with colleagues across our global offices.
* A collaborative office environment and team events.

### **Job Title**

Global Product Manager - Respiratory Accessories

### **Job Description**

As a **Global Product Manager(GPM)- Respiratory Accessories,** you will work on **sustaining and optimizing the existing respiratory accessories portfolio** , including roadmap prioritization, portfolio simplification, margin, and lifecycle performance

**Your role:**

  

**Product roadmap and go-to-market understanding**

* Owns the **execution of the claims roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams** to prioritize validated claims based on market trends and regulatory requirements, while continuously optimizing the strategy through analysis of competitor activity, customer insights, and compliance needs.
* **Maintains relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) to align their insights and advocacy** **with product strategy** , driving engagement through advisory boards and educational initiatives to enhance product credibility, market influence, and thought leadership while measuring impact on market adoption and positioning.
* Collaborates extensively with regional cross-functional teams to guide channel strategies and develop robust go-to-market plans that drive product adoption and revenue growth
* Evaluates market performance using advanced analytics and market insights to assess product success, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions to adjust strategies and enhance market competitiveness. Assists in developing testing protocols by providing support in designing, implementing, and refining procedures to ensure accurate and reliable evaluation of processes, products, or systems.
* **Manages the entire product development lifecycle process from concept through launch, ensuring timely delivery, adherence to quality standards, and alignment with project objectives.** Monitors and analyzes product performance metrics to evaluate success, identifies areas for improvement, and informs strategic decisions for enhancing product effectiveness and achieving business objectives.

**Global Product Management experience**

* Develops and maintains value propositions and creates business cases to effectively communicate the benefits and justify investments, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and supporting decision-making processes. GPM is **accountable for business case development & realization** . GPM is accountable for **commercial, IB, and technical simplicity** .
* GPM is accountable for developing claim (clinical, economic, technical etc) ambition, roadmaps and plans to drive and deliver on price points in partnership with key stakeholders
    
  **Develops comprehensive product, software, and lifecycle specifications aligned with strategic portfolio marketing strategies** , ensuring they meet customer needs and achieve long-term business objectives effectively. Operates with limited supervision and broad guidelines to implement product strategies in collaboration with regional Centers of Excellence, aiming to optimize product margins and ensuring alignment with overall business goals and financial targets.

**Experience in regulated industries**

* Ensures **compliance with regulatory requirements and quality standards throughout the product lifecycle** , collaborating with regulatory affairs and quality assurance teams to mitigate risks and maintain product integrity.
* Maintains a **deep understanding of industry dynamics** , technological advancements, and market shifts and analyzes market trends, competitive landscape, and consumer behavior to anticipate challenges and opportunities.
Identifies opportunities and implements continuous improvement and innovation initiatives in product offerings, informing strategic decisions for the product roadmap to enhance overall performance and align with market demands.  

  
  

**You're the right fit if:**

* You’ve acquired **8+ years of experience** in an international business environment in the field of product management, marketing, or related commercial/strategic role in medical devices or health technology
* You have a **Bachelor's/ master’s degree** in business administration, Marketing, Engineering, Product Management or equivalent.
* Medical-device product manager with **experience in accessories, consumables, sustaining products, and regulated portfolio management.** Exposure to **Regulatory frameworks** (FDA, EU MDR) and Reimbursement considerations
* Expertise experience **delivering complex projects** to meet demanding features, cost, quality and launch targets. Your skills include marketing processes, strategic planning and budgeting; strong written, verbal and presentation communication skills and ability to convey complex messages to influence colleagues; and ability to synthesize market and customer feedback to drive valuable innovations.
* You’re a **highly motivated professional with a passion for medical device solutions** and possess the ability to network and influence in a global matrix organization. You also have the ability to travel >10% of the time both, domestically and globally.
* **Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills** , enabling you to lead cross‑disciplinary discussions with confidence

**How we work together**

We believe that we are better together than apart. This role is part of our **office‑based team** , requiring in‑person collaboration **at least three days per week** in office.

**About Philips**  
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history .
* Learn more about our purpose .

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here .

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle—from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement—for one or more solutions within CDW’s Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
===============================

**Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

**Solution Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

**Solution Development & Delivery**

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

**AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

**Working Model**
=================

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education and/or Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following:

* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Digital Workplace
* Infrastructure Modernization

Experience with:

* Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

**Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**
=========================================

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

title: Senior Product Manager – Edge Platform
description:
**Job title:** Senior Product Manager – Edge Platform.

**Job type:** Full time, Permanent.

**Location:**  Bangalore

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the day-to-day product management and delivery of our Edge Compute platform.

The role sits at the intersection of product, software engineering, infrastructure, operations and consuming teams. You will translate consumer needs and strategic priorities into clear product outcomes, work closely with Engineering to drive delivery, and coordinate across Programme Management and Operations to ensure capabilities are successfully delivered and operationalised.

This is a highly technical product role requiring strong product judgement, technical fluency and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, engineering-led environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own product execution: Manage and prioritise the product backlog, lead planning and refinement, clarify requirements and acceptance criteria, and work with Engineering to resolve product questions and delivery blockers.
* Partner with consumers: Understand and triage requests from teams using the Edge platform, translate needs into product requirements, manage expectations and ensure the platform continues to meet consumer needs.
* Drive engineering & operational alignment: Partner closely with Software Engineering, Infrastructure, Architecture, Security and Operations to deliver reliable, secure and supportable platform capabilities. Ensure workflows and automation built by Engineering are operationally ready and can be effectively adopted and run by Operations.
* Coordinate programmes: Work closely with Programme Management to align product delivery with wider programme milestones, dependencies, risks and commitments, ensuring issues are surfaced and managed early.
* Evolve the platform: Translate the Edge product strategy and roadmap into actionable initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify infrastructure consumption through automation, APIs and self-service capabilities.
* Drive outcomes: Balance consumer experience, engineering effort, scalability, reliability, security and operational supportability when making product decisions.

**Experience**

* Experience managing platform, infrastructure or developer-focused products from discovery through delivery.
* Strong experience working day-to-day with engineering teams, including backlog management, prioritisation, sprint planning and requirements definition.
* Experience working with multiple consuming teams and coordinating complex cross-team dependencies.
* Background in technical domains such as compute, networking, cloud/edge platforms, APIs or automation.
* Experience working in complex enterprise environments across Engineering, Infrastructure, Architecture, Operations and Programme Management.

**Skills**

* Strong product discovery, prioritisation and delivery skills.
* Technical fluency across infrastructure and software engineering, with an understanding of APIs, automation and platform technologies.
* Ability to move confidently between technical detail, consumer needs and business outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills.
* Highly organised, pragmatic and comfortable operating in an engineering-led environment with ambiguity and competing priorities.

Pay: Up to ₹4,800,000.00 per year

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.  
In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. You'll shape how the platform evolves across richer ADE experiences (harnesses like Claude Code and Codex CLI), Chakra Assist for evaluation, richer session observation (screen sharing, A/V), and reporting across in-product, exports, APIs and MCP. You'll work closely with engineers as collaborators and as the product's core customer and user base including senior engineering leadership as stakeholders who care deeply about this space.

#### **What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for how HackerRank Interviews evaluates AI-assisted development including richer ADE harnesses, Chakra Assist, and session observation capabilities.
* Define how the platform captures and surfaces signals on how candidates prompt, review and apply AI-generated work, so interviewers get clearer, structured evidence.
* Drive the reporting and integration strategy across in-product reporting, exports, APIs and MCP.
* Engage directly with engineering customers and users including senior engineering leadership as the primary audience for this product, translating their needs into roadmap decisions.
* Represent the product in high-visibility, customer-facing moments with composure, including when executives engage directly and unexpectedly.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship production-quality, AI-native interview experiences.
* Embrace AI - in how we operate, as well as in the product.

#### **Who you are**

* Overall 7+ years of total professional experience including at least 1 year of hands-on Software Engineering.
* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably building B2B SaaS, enterprise products and/or tech services and/or platforms, and you are currently working as a PM today.
* Comfortable being the technical/product voice in a room full of engineers, including stakeholders like senior engineering leadership
* Able to stay composed and sound under sudden high-visibility pressure for example, a CTO persona dropping into a live customer channel.
* A strategic thinker who can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* Deeply passionate about AI using it as a reflex across your own workflows, not just in the product you build.
* Ability to deep dive into ambitious problem statements and create customer value.
* Proven track record of successfully launching and growing new products and/or significant features.
* Ability to work in a fast paced cross team, cross geo environment and to deliver on a common vision.
* Ability to work with engineers, designers and analysts and be comfortable presenting to non-technical/business stakeholders and customers.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Hands-on fluency with agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or similar) deep enough to reason about what a good AI-assisted engineering actually looks like.
* Experience designing or owning a GTM motion where the buyer and user were engineers or engineering leadership, rather than a traditional non-technical economic buyer.
* Experience operating in a lean, founder-style team with no dedicated marketing support i.e., you've personally built your own sales decks, messaging and customer-facing materials before, not just briefed a marketing team.
* Background in HR tech, talent assessment, or technical hiring.
* Experience building reporting/analytics or API-level integrations (e.g. MCP, data exports) for a technical audience.

#### **You will thrive in this role if you**

* **You are a builder at heart.** You enjoy creating something from scratch, transforming ideas into tangible, high-impact products.
* **Ambiguity excites you**. You're comfortable working in undefined spaces, carving out clarity where little exists, and defining a clear vision and strategy.
* **You take a customer-first approach.** You excel at identifying unmet customer needs and turning those insights into innovative product solutions.
* **You are a strategic thinker.** You can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and make decisions that balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* **You thrive in fast-paced environments.** You're energised by working on high-impact initiatives where priorities can shift as you gain new insights.
* **You have a bias for action.** You're not afraid to experiment, iterate, and learn quickly in pursuit of delivering exceptional outcomes.
* **You are deeply passionate about AI.** You're in the weeds and trying out AI tools constantly and are at a point where you are using AI as a reflex to try and automate several workflows in your life and 10x yourself.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. description:
### **Who We Are**

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. With low-code extensibility and enterprise-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

**Who we are**

Simpplr builds AI-powered intranet for modern enterprises. Our platform unifies employee engagement, enablement, and services, leveraging state-of-the-art AI models to deliver a seamless, cohesive, and personalized employee experience for everyone — wherever and however they work.

Our mission is to transform the work experience for billions of people across the world. Because we believe that when work is good, life is better.™

Trusted by more than 1,000 leading brands, including DocuSign, Penske, Splunk, Nutanix, Okta, Eurostar, and SoFi, our customers are achieving measurable improvements in employee engagement, productivity, and accelerated business performance.

Simpplr is headquartered in Silicon Valley, CA with offices in the UK, Canada, and India, and is backed by Sapphire Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and Tola Capital. Learn more at simpplr.com.

  

**The role**

We have more ideas than we can build. Your job is to figure out which ones are real, and turn the survivors into a product specification sharp enough for engineering to build from.

You won't be generating ideas!! You'll be the person who decides which ones deserve investment — through live customer conversations, rigorous market sizing, and a written case that leadership can act on. Some of what you look at should die. Killing an idea well is as valuable here as championing one !!

**What you'll do**

* Take a rough concept and design the fastest honest test of whether there's a real need behind it
* Run customer and prospect interviews; separate what people said from what you concluded
* Size the opportunity — TAM/SAM, pricing, unit economics — and be clear about which assumptions the number actually rests on
* Write the recommendation memo: build, don't build, or build something narrower. Own the call.
* Turn a validated concept into a PRD — problem, scope, what's in the first version and what isn't
* Work with engineering leads on feasibility early enough that it changes the spec, not after

**What we're looking for**

* MBA from IIM A/B/C/L/I/K or equivalent.
* Exceptional structured writing. Your memos are the product of this role.
* High Comfort with numbers: financial modeling in Excel/Sheets, basic SQL, product analytics
* Can hold a real conversation with a senior Global executive based in developed markets (or a frustrated customer without a script !!)
* Already using AI tools in how you work, not just aware of them

**What you get**

Direct access to CXOs on a daily basis, real ownership of investment recommendations, and a short path between your analysis and what actually gets built.

### **Your Voice, Unfiltered:**

We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview

Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!

If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

### **Simpplr’s Hub-Hybrid-Remote Model:**

At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.

* **Hub -** **100% work from Simpplr office.** Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full-time.
* **Hybrid -** **Hybrid work from home and office.** Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in-person collaboration on a regular basis.
* **Remote - 100% remote.** Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

title: Product Manager III, Amazon Business India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon Business:  
Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.  
At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.
  
  
The Role:  
Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?  
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.  
  
The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.  
  
We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:  
  
1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.  
  
2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
  

* Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
* Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
* Outbound channels — email and push notifications
* Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

  
You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for both onsite shopping experience and off-app marketing tech — creating a unified engagement layer across all customer touchpoints
* Personalization: Drive the development of personalization capabilities that leverage business context and behavioral signals to deliver relevant experiences across onsite and offsite channels
* Customer Understanding: Develop deep understanding of business customer lifecycle patterns, procurement behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we engage customers
* Experience Design: Design and implement customer experiences that are contextual, frictionless, and consistent across the onsite journey and outbound channels
* Marketing Automation: Build and scale marketing automation systems that enable personalized, multi-channel customer journeys — from acquisition through retention — with self-serve tooling for marketing team
* Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to B2B customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Amazon Business ahead of shifting customer behavior
* Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
* Collaboration: The roadmap will be a mix of India-first products and India adaptations of global product features. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams across Amazon India and Amazon Worldwide

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing key product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning you are in a design review, debating trade-offs on a new feature with your engineering and design partners. After lunch you draft a product requirements document, pressure-testing assumptions with data from recent experiments. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming launch plan and resolve open dependencies.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

description:
Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.

Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.

Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.

Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.

The Playbook

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

Every MetaGO journey kicks off with a massive 35+ biomarker deep dive. From there, we bring in the heavy hitters—endocrinologists, cardiologists, and internal medicine experts—to craft a highly personalized roadmap.

Throw in GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the MetaGO app. With absolute legends like Dr. Kaushal Patel leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.

The Growth & Product Team

Where the GO of MetaGO happens!

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

Here’s What You’ll Be Driving

* The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.

* Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

* The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.

* The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.

* The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For

* Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.

* Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.

* Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.

* Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.

* Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.

* Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.

* Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.

* Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.

* Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)

Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)

We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.

If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.

Let’s build something epic together.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

**Role Overview**
=================

We are seeking a technically strong and execution-oriented Technical Product Manager to help advance the Windchill+ SaaS platform. The role partners closely with Product Management, Platform R&D, Quality Assurance, Cloud Engineering, and service operations teams to translate platform requirements into well-defined, executable development backlogs.

The immediate focus is platform release execution performed directly with R&D teams. This includes release readiness, technical improvements, security and compliance changes, infrastructure evolution, validation, retrofitting, and other work required to advance and maintain the platform. The TPM will operate under the mentorship of the lead Windchill+ Platform TPM while progressively assuming ownership of recurring backlog, dependency, and release-management responsibilities.

Over time, the role will expand into broader service-level improvements. The TPM will help define how platform capabilities affect the Windchill+ service experience and will apply Design for Operations thinking earlier in the development lifecycle. Design for Operations is an evolving practice within the organization, and this role will help establish practical ways to incorporate operational requirements, installed-base impacts, customer enablement, and service readiness into backlog definition.

  

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

The responsibilities below represent a superset of the work this role may perform. Actual day-to-day focus will vary over the course of any given release and across releases. The TPM is not expected to perform all of these responsibilities all of the time, or to do so without support from the broader team.

* Partner directly with Windchill+ Platform R&D teams to define, refine, prioritize, and maintain executable product backlogs.

* Translate product, service, security, compliance, and operational requirements into clear deliverables, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and release outcomes.

* Own day-to-day TPM execution for assigned platform initiatives through discovery, planning, development, validation, and release.

* Coordinate platform readiness for Windchill product releases, maintenance releases, security updates, supporting component changes, and installed-base retrofits.

* Work with engineering and QA leads to assess technical approaches, dependencies, resource needs, delivery estimates, validation requirements, and release feasibility.

* Lead backlog refinement and support sprint planning, PI planning, release planning, story acceptance, and TPM readouts with globally distributed Agile teams.

* Manage work across Product Management, Platform R&D, QA, Cloud Engineering, operations, integrated products, and shared services, converting dependencies into explicit backlog and accountable ownership.

* Facilitate technical discovery and design spikes when requirements, architecture, or operational impacts are not sufficiently understood.

* Maintain a reliable view of planned, completed, deferred, and at-risk work; identify decisions and escalations early enough to protect delivery.

* Balance urgent tactical needs with longer-term platform objectives and roadmap priorities.

* Begin applying Design for Operations to assigned work by considering provisioning, configuration, monitoring, support, maintenance, security, upgrades, retrofitting, validation, and customer enablement during backlog definition.

* Continuously strengthen technical and product-management expertise through hands-on collaboration, mentoring, and formal or self-directed learning.

**Growth Opportunities**
========================

As experience and organizational practices mature, the TPM will expand from hands-on platform execution into broader service-level ownership:

* Independently manage multiple platform workstreams across releases, including more complex cross-team and installed-base changes.

* Lead selected Design for Operations assessments and help evolve the organization's methods, templates, and working practices.

* Define how proposed capabilities change the experience for customers, administrators, partners, support teams, and service operators.

* Own selected service improvements from definition through release, connecting the intended service experience to the required platform, automation, documentation, enablement, and operational backlog.

* Partner with the Offering Owner on changes that affect the Service Guide, service catalog, customer commitments, or broader offering definition.

* Provide broader Windchill+ TPM coverage, enabling the lead platform TPM to concentrate on strategic, cross-offering, and technically complex initiatives.

**Skills and Knowledge**
========================

**Required**
------------

* Strong experience with enterprise software development, platform engineering, cloud services, DevOps, systems integration, or SaaS delivery teams.

* Demonstrated ability to translate technical and business requirements into an executable Agile backlog.

* Experience writing deliverables, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.

* Experience prioritizing backlogs and performing story or release acceptance.

* Working knowledge of Scrum, Agile planning, backlog refinement, and iterative software delivery.

* Ability to understand complex technical dependencies and drive decisions across multiple engineering and stakeholder teams.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, architects, QA engineers, operations teams, Product Managers, and senior stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently while maintaining alignment across globally distributed teams.

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, science, mathematics, or an equivalent technical discipline.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Windchill installation, deployment, administration, integrations, or functional capabilities.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure or other public or private cloud platforms.

* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, Docker, Kubernetes, or enterprise application deployment technologies.

* Familiarity with Java-based enterprise application architectures, REST APIs, scripting, Linux, and secure communication technologies.

* Experience with Jira or similar requirements and backlog management systems.

* Understanding of application security, compliance, identity and access management, monitoring, and operational validation.

* Experience supporting SaaS releases, platform updates, maintenance releases, security updates, or installed-base retrofits.

* Exposure to service design, operational readiness, or product-to-operations transition practices.

**Experience**
==============

* Typically 6 or more years of relevant experience in enterprise software development, technical product management, engineering delivery, cloud services, systems integration, deployment, or customer-facing technical roles.

* Formal Product Manager or Product Owner experience is valuable but is not required when the candidate has demonstrated ownership of complex technical delivery and engineering backlog.

* Experience coordinating work across multiple teams or systems is strongly preferred.

* The candidate should be comfortable starting in a hands-on execution role and growing into broader service-level ownership.

  
  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year
  
  

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.

title: Product Manager, Doctor Experience
description:
**About the Company**

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

**Role Summary**

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
* Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.
* Bring member data such as blood diagnostics, CGM readings, symptoms and progress into a clean, usable view that supports faster clinical decisions.
* Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
* Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
* Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
* Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
* Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
* Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

**Requirements (Must-Haves)**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
* Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.
* Experience gathering insight directly from doctors and clinical teams and turning it into shipped product.
* Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
* Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
* Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
* Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
* Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
* Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
* Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

  
**Benefits**  
  
Why Join Elevate Now

* Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
* Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.
